quote: Theorem 3. Let F be a continuous distribution function with ess-inf F = 0. Then CP(λ, F ) satisfies (SD) for all λ ∈ R++ if and only if F ∈ H.
family: Compound Poisson CP(λ,F): X = Σ_{i=1}^N Yi, N ~ Poisson(λ), Yi ~ F iid
compared: linear combinations of iid compound-Poisson variables under majorization — necessary AND sufficient condition

conclusion.direction: CP(λ,F) satisfies (SD) for all λ > 0 ⇔ F ∈ H (ΣηiXi <=st ΣθiXi for θ ⪯ η)

quantifiers: all λ > 0; n = 2 (reduction); all θ ⪯ η
ambiguity: First necessity result for (SD). Remark 5: if F ∈ H, (SD) also holds for compound mixed Poisson CP(Λ,F) with random Λ.
